notes.text: Fixed screen fades in MCC campaign maps.
Fixed repeat races in Rally and weapon movement speeds in Bigass.
Fixed repeated equipment selection in MeinCrap.
Fixed a dark layer over Frogfoot's water.
Fixed missing light glows on AMD graphics cards.
Improved rendering performance on NVIDIA graphics cards.
Added text chat for private multiplayer games.
Mute a player's voice and text chat from the scoreboard.
Added streamer mode to hide offensive words in names and other text.
Access multiplayer chat settings from the pause menu, including co-op.
Raised the maximum map sharing speeds.
Refreshed the browser launcher with a clearer Ready to Play screen.
Improved browser multiplayer on unreliable connections.
Fixed the browser loading notice and joining games from browser rooms.
